entities.name: Gregor Strniša
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gregor Strniša was a Slovenian poet, playwright, and songwriter. He is considered one of the most important Slovene-language poet of the second half of the 20th century. He spent most of his life away from public light, and has gained widespread recognition only after his death.
